summary.en: Jordan has conducted fresh airstrikes in Syria, claiming they targeted Islamic State hideouts linked to a recent church attack that killed nine people, while Syrian authorities report civilian casualties from the attacks. Syria has condemned the strikes as a breach of its airspace and an unacceptable violation. A joint Jordan-Syria security committee is being formed to investigate the incidents. 2,732 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Jordan har gjennomført nye luftangrep i Syria, og hevder at de rammet IS-skjulesteder knyttet til et nylig kirkebombardement som drepte ni personer, mens syriske myndigheter rapporterer sivile tap som følge av angrepene. Syria har fordømt angrepene som et brudd på deres luftrom og en uakseptabel overtredelse. En felles sikkerhetskomité bestående av Jordan og Syria blir opprettet for å etterforske hendelsene. 2 732 dødsfall knyttet til kamper fant sted i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
